newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Wheat sales light, basis firms.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Wheat sales light, basis firms.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat rose at several locations, supported by slow farmer selling and a drop Tuesday in KCBT HRW wheat futures, grain dealers said.
There was also concern that this week's CCC catalog sale may increase availability and spark weakness over the next few days.

Kansas farmers focused on the sorghum harvest, which was producing average to above average yields and test weights. Yields of 100 bushels or more were reported from some dryland fields with test weights at 56 lbs per bushel or better.
"The test weights are the biggest I've ever seen," said a central Kansas dealer. "We got rain (during the growing season) when we needed it."
Most of the sorghum was being stored as farmers either await higher prices or want to defer income until 1997.
